snippet.title: Click & Mine - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Click & Mine is coming to Steam in 2026!

You can check it out and wishlist it at:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4506000/Click__Mine

Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game where you mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.
